name: echomeet-functions
description: Server-side notifications and scheduled cleanup for EchoMeet.

scripts.test:profile-images-emulator: npx --yes node@22 node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,storage --project=echomeet-test --config ../firebase.json "npx --yes node@22 --test --test-concurrency=1 test/profile_images.emulator.js"
scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --only functions
scripts.deploy: npm run build && firebase deploy --only functions --project echomeet-app
